title: B2 Milestone 5: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Formidable! Has superado el Quinto Hito del Nivel B2. Ahora dominas el uso del énfasis en las oraciones y el lenguaje idiomático avanzado que usan los líderes en reuniones de directorio.

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 21 a 24 del nivel B2: 
- Cleft Sentences para dar énfasis (It was the CEO who... / What we need is...). 
- Hábitos y Estados pasados (used to, would, be used to, get used to).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 21 to 24 of the B2 level: Cleft Sentences for emphasis, and Past Habits and States.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos tu uso de frases avanzadas: 
- Phrasal Verbs 1 (iron out, bring up, pull off, look into). 
- Business Idioms 1 (get the ball rolling, touch base, think outside the box). 
¡Demuestra tu fluidez!
parts.audio: We will also test your use of advanced phrases: Phrasal Verbs part 1, and Business Idioms part 1. Show your fluency!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: ____ surprised me the most was his attitude. (Lo que me sorprendió...).
questions.explanation: What surprised me was... (Cleft sentence para acciones/cosas).

questions.question: ____ was the CFO who found the error in the budget. (Fue el CFO quien...).
questions.explanation: It was [persona] who... (Cleft sentence para personas).

questions.question: When we worked in the old office, we ____ go out for lunch every Friday. (Solíamos ir - acción).
questions.explanation: Would (para acciones repetidas en el pasado).

questions.question: I can't ____ waking up at 5 AM. I'm always tired. (Acostumbrarme a).
questions.explanation: Get used to (proceso de adaptarse a algo).

questions.question: We need to ____ a few details before we can sign the contract. (Resolver / Planchar).
Winning that account was impossible, but our team ____ it ____! (Lo logró).
Let's get the ball ____ on this project immediately. (Poner en marcha).
We can't ____ corners on security. We must do it right. (Tomar atajos).
____ I really want is a week off work. (Lo que yo quiero...).
He ____ have a BMW, but he sold it. (Solía tener - estado).
questions.explanation: Used to (para estados pasados de posesión). No se puede usar 'would' con 'have' en este sentido.

questions.question: I don't know why it failed, but I will ____ it. (Investigarlo).
During the negotiation, don't ____ the salary issue. (Mencionarlo).
I need to get up to ____ on the latest numbers. (Ponerme al día).
We are on the same ____ regarding the strategy. (De acuerdo).
I will ____ a contract and send it to you tomorrow. (Redactar).
Unfortunately, the deal ____ because of a disagreement. (Fracasó / Se cayó).
Let's put this idea on the back ____ for now. (En segundo plano).
Don't beat around the ____. Tell me the truth. (Irse por las ramas).
Did you ____ work here before? (¿Solías trabajar?).
____ is money that makes the world go round. (Es el dinero lo que...).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: ____ we need is time. (Lo que)
____ was John who did it. (Fue)
He ____ buy us coffee. (Solía - acción con W)
I can't ____ used to this. (Acostumbrarme a con G)
____ out the details. (Resolver/Planchar con I)
Don't ____ up the budget. (Mencionar con B)
Get the ball ____. (Empezar con R)
____ corners. (Tomar atajos con C)
Get up to ____. (Al día con S)
Call it a ____. (Terminar por hoy con D)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración para tu examen final del bloque 5.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What we need is more time.
options: What we need is more time.
It is more time that we need.
What we needed was more time.
questions.correct_answer: What we need is more time.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was the CEO who fired him.
options: It was the CEO who fired him.
It was the CEO that fired him.
What the CEO did was fire him.
questions.correct_answer: It was the CEO who fired him.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

We will buy pizza every Friday.
